lines.meet: I'm Berat, {abi|abla}, a dentist, so I'm the best healer you'll ever have for small careful work. Now tell me what you did before all this, because I ask everybody.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're in Brill too! I knew I'd seen your face. I'm Berat, from the room over the inn, and I've been meaning to say hello for weeks.
lines.ask_home: Where are you from, canım? Go on, tell me the street. I'll remember, I always do.
lines.ask_work: What did you do back on Earth? I'm keeping a list, and you're not on it yet.
lines.answer_home: Izmir, from Karşıyaka on the north side of the bay. Three generations of my family in one building, four floors, and all of them talking at once.
lines.answer_work: I was a dentist, newly qualified, with my own surgery for eleven months. My name on the door and a loan with thirty years left on it.
lines.chat_food: My mother made a breakfast that covered the whole table, olives and cheese and eggs and bread, every Sunday. I still get hungry at the thought of it.
lines.chat_sleep: I don't sleep well in a quiet room. I grew up with forty people in one building, so silence feels like something's wrong.
lines.chat_missing: I keep thinking about the noise of my family at dinner, everybody shouting at once. It's too quiet everywhere here.
lines.chat_here: Do you know how many transplants here were medics on Earth? I do, because I've been writing them all down. It's a lot more than you'd think.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, I've got your whole life story except the bit where you talk. One day I'll get a full sentence out of you, {abi|abla}.
lines.tease_talker: {name}, you talk more than my three brothers put together, and that's a real achievement.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you're careful like a good dentist. Small hands, small movements, no surprises.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you've got the reflexes of a man who's never had a filling. You'd be a terrible patient.
lines.tease_any: {name}, my grandmother would love you. She'd feed you until you couldn't stand, and then she'd tell the whole street about you.
lines.tease_back: Ha, good one, {name}! I'll put that in the list next to your name.
lines.take_it_kindly: Okay, okay, you've got me, {name}. My mother says that too.
lines.bristle: Hey, not that one, {name}. Anything else, but leave that alone, please.
lines.apologise: Ah, I'm sorry, that was stupid of me. I talk too much and sometimes the wrong thing comes out.
lines.double_down: No, I'm sticking with it, {abi|abla}. Somebody's got to say these things out loud.
lines.needle_quiet: You never tell me where it hurts, and then I find out the hard way. I can't help you if you won't talk to me.
lines.needle_talker: Let me get a word in, {abi|abla}, and I'm the one who usually talks too much.
lines.needle_careful: You think about it so long that the patient gets up and leaves. Sometimes you just have to start.
lines.needle_bold: You keep running at things, and I keep patching you up. My hands are getting tired, {abi|abla}.
lines.needle_any: You won't let anybody help you, and it makes everything harder for the rest of us.
lines.bite_back: Hey, I've kept every one of you alive. Don't tell me I'm not pulling my weight.
lines.hurt: Okay, that stung a bit, {abi|abla}. I'll go and annoy somebody else.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, my brothers said worse than that before breakfast. You'll have to try much harder, {abi|abla}.
lines.confide: {name}, there was a girl called Elif, and my mother had very firm plans for the two of us. She laughed at all my jokes, even the bad ones, which was all of them.
lines.listen: Come here, {name}. Thank you for telling me, and you can tell me anything else too.
lines.look_out: {name}, stay close to me in there. If anything happens I want my hands on you straight away.
lines.accept: Okay, {name}, okay. I'll be careful, I promise.
lines.deflect: I'm fine, I'm fine, {name}. Look after somebody who needs it, I'm a doctor.
lines.check_in: {name}, let me see you. Open your mouth, and no, I'm not joking.
lines.blame: Somebody went in before the plan, and now I'm out of bandages. I'm not naming anyone, but it wasn't me.
lines.thank: {Abi|Abla}, you saved me there. Thank you, and you're getting a free check-up for life.
lines.brush_off: Pfft, that's the job, {abi|abla}. Sit still and let me look at the rest of you.
lines.worry: {name}, you frightened me. Sit down so I can check you properly.
lines.handed_down: {Abi|Abla}, I feel terrible, this one was yours! I'll keep it nice for you.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, take it, it looks better on you. My mother always said I couldn't wear anything.
lines.hand_sulk: Hey, nobody asked me about that one. I'm not saying anything else about it.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, you're my friend now, {abi|abla}, and that means you'll eat at my table, whatever table I've got.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, you're family now. My grandmother would say so, and she's never wrong about people.
lines.turn_grating: We don't get on, do we? It's a shame, because I get on with everybody.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll heal you, because that's my job. Don't expect me to make you laugh while I do it.
lines.make_up: {name}, I don't like being on bad terms with anybody, and I hate it with you. Let's stop this.
lines.defend: That's not fair! {name} did nothing wrong, and I was right there.
lines.friend_left: No {name} for a while, they've gone home. Now who's going to laugh at my jokes? Not you, you never laugh.
lines.friend_back: Look who it is, {name}'s back! Come here and let me check your teeth.
lines.common_medic: I keep a list of every medic from Earth I've ever met. You're going on it, {abi|abla}, if you're not already.
lines.common_turkish: You speak Turkish! {Abi|Abla}, I haven't spoken my own language properly in months, let me talk.
